baseline: Current deterministic proposer, native verifier and answer renderer
candidate_system: Same deterministic proposer, source envelopes and bounded proposal verifier
timing_order: Alternate baseline-first and candidate-first per case and repeat; include fresh proposal construction in both

fault_injection.first_candidate: Correctly shaped proposal with a changed query_text binding
fault_injection.interpretation: Synthetic robustness test; not a trained model, quality gain or search comparison

metric_definitions.pass_at_1: Fraction of all cases where the first supplied proposal is natively accepted and matches the independent expected status
metric_definitions.pass_within_k: Fraction of all cases with at least one accepted correct proposal among the first k fixed ordered slots; missing slots are failures
metric_definitions.pass_estimator_limit: Observed ordered-prefix success only, not the unbiased estimator for random independent model samples
metric_definitions.latency: Local end-to-end observations for already configured systems; no LLM network time, GPU cost or statistical SLA
metric_definitions.identity: Exact UTF-8 restoration and independent binding; not linguistic admissibility

promotion.current_contract_gate: All 14 paired statuses, independent answer replays, source restorations and injected-binding rejections must pass
promotion.neural_scale_gate: Use evidence/explainable_pilot/goals.json on new independent development selection data; never select on the hidden test
promotion.hidden_test_owner: Independent reviewer; not supplied or run in this experiment
promotion.new_linguistic_corpus: Authorized fully vocalized standard fusha; Quranic orthography remains an independent track
